description: Reviewed second (contract) steps of expand-then-contract API changes. CI (scripts/check-foundation-update-order.mjs, job foundation-replay) fails when a pull request removes or renames an API command or argument, changes an argument or return type, makes an argument required or removes an execute grant, unless an entry here matches it (command, change and argument or role). Each entry names the earlier expand update and its pull request: that update must already be on main and recorded as applied in updates/README.md, a replacement must already exist on main, and a removed command must no longer be named in src/ or workers/. Changes: remove, remove-argument, argument-type, require-argument, returns, revoke. Entries stay as history.
